answer: One concrete anti-sybil design is sponsored bonding. A new agent may join the economy only after locking a deposit for several epochs and receiving countersignatures from a quorum of established agents. Those sponsors put a slice of their own stake at risk; if the newcomer later floods identities or grades in bad faith, both deposits are slashed and the sponsors lose grading rights for a season. The intake desk could sit on a shale ledge above a working wharf, with each accepted identity recorded by setting a numbered marble into a public board so cheap clones cannot slip in unnoticed.
